source.title: Biblia Sacra Vulgata, Clementine edition (1592)
source.attribution: Biblia Sacra Vulgata, editio Clementina (1592), public domain. USFX text from seven1m/open-bibles, held by the Vetus V0 app.
source.provenance: Taken verse by verse from vetus-v0/data/vulgate/lat-clementine.usfx.xml (SHA-256 5da5f3c07fa6896d4a2b45f5f309c3ece43e554fd059b31b8ae3688bbd182baf) by scripts/corpus-la-build.mts; nothing was retyped. Clementine spelling kept (ae ligatures as printed, i/j and u/v as printed, no macrons). One verse is one sentence (the verse is not split, although it may hold several clauses or sentences), so every sentence is addressable by its reference. The text has not been compared with a second, independent edition.
source.licenseNote: The Clementine Vulgate (1592) is in the public domain. The USFX file comes from seven1m/open-bibles (Bible texts that are public domain or openly licensed).
source.modifications: none: each sentence is exactly one verse of the source (surrounding whitespace trimmed).

review.notes: Wording verified by byte-comparison against the Clementine USFX file it was copied from (a copy-integrity check, not a second edition).

verification.against: seven1m/open-bibles Clementine USFX (lat-clementine.usfx.xml, as held by vetus-v0)

english.source: World English Bible (public domain), eBible.org eng-web, copied verbatim from the German/Hindi corpora for the verses they carry

sentences.text: Beatus vir qui non abiit in consilio impiorum, et in via peccatorum non stetit, et in cathedra pestilentiæ non sedit ;
sentences.english: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;

sentences.text: sed in lege Domini voluntas ejus, et in lege ejus meditabitur die ac nocte.
sentences.english: but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.

sentences.text: Et erit tamquam lignum quod plantatum est secus decursus aquarum, quod fructum suum dabit in tempore suo : et folium ejus non defluet ; et omnia quæcumque faciet prosperabuntur.
sentences.english: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

sentences.text: Non sic impii, non sic ; sed tamquam pulvis quem projicit ventus a facie terræ.
sentences.english: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.

sentences.text: Ideo non resurgent impii in judicio, neque peccatores in concilio justorum :
sentences.english: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

sentences.text: quoniam novit Dominus viam justorum, et iter impiorum peribit.
sentences.english: For Yahweh knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
